bio.text: Damon Connolly was elected to the California State Assembly in November 2022 to represent the 12th Assembly District. He chairs the Assembly Committee on Environmental Safety and Toxic Materials.

Before the Assembly he served as a Marin County Supervisor, vice mayor of San Rafael, a two-term San Rafael city councilmember and school board president, and he worked as a Supervising Deputy California Attorney General before opening his own law practice in San Rafael.
He is a Bay Area native who attended college and law school at UC Berkeley, and he has lived in San Rafael with his wife and two daughters for over twenty-five years.
